title: Khatri–Rao rows for building G: decoding cost O(qdr) is omitted (risk of hidden O(M))

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Gap (new, specific to the explicit-`G` strategy in current `solution.tex`).**

Lemma `lem:G` and **both** algorithm boxes assume the row subset $\tilde Z\in\mathbb R^{q\times r}$ with $\tilde Z_{l,:}=Z_{j_l,:}$ is available as input, and §1 says only that the integer $j_l$ "is used only to pick a single row of $Z$." But $Z=A_d\odot\cdots\odot A_1\in\mathbb R^{M\times r}$ must never be materialized (it is $M\times r$). No cost or formula is given for obtaining $Z_{j_l,:}$ from the stored factors, so as written a reader who builds $\tilde Z$ by forming $Z$ incurs $O(M)$ work — exactly what the problem forbids.

**What must be added.** Two steps, both $O(M)$-free:
1. *Index decode.* Factor $j_l-1$ in mixed radix (column-major over modes $i\neq k$): $j_l-1=\sum_{i\neq k} c_i^{(l)}\prod_{i'<i,\,i'\neq k} n_{i'}$, giving the $d-1$ constituent indices $c_i^{(l)}$ in $O(d)$ per observation.
2. *Row assembly.* $Z_{j_l,:}=\circledast_{i\neq k} A_i\big(c_i^{(l)},:\big)$ (entrywise/Hadamard product of the $d-1$ factor rows), $O((d-1)r)$ per row.

Total to build $\tilde Z$: $O(qdr)$, touching only $O(qd)$ stored factor rows — no $N$- or $M$-sized object. (Numerically verified: $Z_{j,:}$ equals the Hadamard product of the $d-1$ factor rows.)

The "Form $G$" line in both Alg.~`alg:direct` and Alg.~`alg:pcg` should be annotated with this $O(qdr)$ decode cost; without it the central "no $O(M)$ work" claim is not actually established for the assembly of $G$.
